description_english: Steps for preparing for church, entering, and offering the supplied prayers.
description_amharic: ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መዘጋጀት፣ መግባትና የቀረቡትን ጸሎቶች ማቅረብ የሚመለከቱ ደረጃዎች።

description_english: The order of prayer, seven prayer times, and three kinds of prayer.
description_amharic: የጸሎት ሥርዓት፣ ሰባቱ የጸሎት ጊዜያትና ሦስቱ የጸሎት ዓይነቶች።

description_english: Private, family, and public prayer, together with Saatat and hymns.
description_amharic: የግል፣ የቤተሰብና የማኅበር ጸሎት፣ እንዲሁም ሰዓታትና ዝማሬ።

description_english: Priestly prayers, the three parts of the Liturgy, and the fourteen anaphoras.

description_english: Posture, the sign of the Cross, and attention during prayer.
description_amharic: በጸሎት ጊዜ መቆም፣ የመስቀል ምልክት ማድረግና ትኩረት።

description_english: Litany, prayer for the dead, commemorations, and other intercessions.
description_amharic: ምሕላ፣ ለሙታን ጸሎት፣ መታሰቢያዎችና ሌሎች ምልጃዎች።
